title: Watchmen
author: Alan Moore, Dave Gibbons
current_text: A complaint about Watchmen at a high school in Harrisonburg, Virginia, was reported in October 2001; the challenge appeared unsuccessful because the high school library held a copy.

sources.quote: The first Watchmen complaint, at a high school in Harrisonburg, Virginia, was reported in October of 2001. OIF removes specific identifying details from the information it releases to the public, but the high school library in Harrisonburg holds a copy of the book, so it appears the challenge was unsuccessful.
sources.title: Case Study: Watchmen – Comic Book Legal Defense Fund
